entities.summary: Allen Jamel Lazard is an American professional football wide receiver. He played college football for the Iowa State Cyclones and was signed by the Jacksonville Jaguars as an undrafted free agent in 2018. He has previously played in the National Football League (NFL) for the Green Bay Packers and New York Jets.
